## What changed and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue and article when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For numerical changes, explain the evidence
for new values. For rendering changes, include a figure or a link to the CI artifact.

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Article manifest and data provenance are updated, if affected.
- [ ] Dependency changes include an updated `poetry.lock`, if affected.
- [ ] Generated outputs are kept out of the commit.
- [ ] Any required website follow-up is linked or recorded in the manifest.
